How to Buy a Vehicle

1. Find the car of your dreams

Start by searching for a vehicle in the USA that meets your requirements.


The Stat.VIN search engine and advanced filters allow you to conveniently browse a large database of vehicles available at auctions. 

Registration is not required to view lots. Creating an account is only necessary if you plan to participate in bidding. The registration and account activation process takes no more than 5 minutes. 

After registration, you will be able to:
 

  • track vehicles of interest in one section;
     
  • add lots to your watchlist;
     
  • view final prices of completed auctions.
     

The Stat.VIN platform is constantly evolving — we regularly add new features and tools for user convenience.

2. Pay a refundable deposit

To participate in auctions, a refundable deposit is required — this is a mandatory condition of the Copart and IAAI auction houses.
Stat.VIN does not charge any additional fees for participating in auctions. If necessary, you can request a deposit refund at any time through your personal account. After the deposit is credited, you can place bids on the same day.

If you win an auction, the funds will be temporarily blocked until the vehicle is paid for. If your bid does not win, the deposit is automatically unlocked. You can use it to participate in other auctions or return the funds to your bank account using the deposit refund function.

The deposit amount determines your auction participation limits:
 

  • Up to USD 2,000 — allows bidding up to USD 20,000 on up to 3 lots simultaneously;
     
  • More than USD 2,000 — equals 10% of the total bidding limit. The number of lots available for simultaneous bidding is calculated based on the rule that a USD 600 deposit equals bidding on 1 lot.

3. The auction starts right now – feel the excitement!

Determine the maximum amount you are willing to pay for the selected vehicle.
The calculator on the page helps you calculate all related costs in advance. After order confirmation, the vehicle will be listed at the auction through Stat.VIN during the auction house’s live bidding.

It is important to note that US car auctions take place in two stages:
 

  • Pre-Bid — a bidding stage that lasts several days and starts from $0;
     
  • Live Auction — dynamic bidding that starts from the highest Pre-Bid offer.
     

If no additional bids are placed, the highest Pre-Bid wins. This ensures maximum bidding efficiency and increases the chances of purchasing a vehicle at the lowest possible price.

4. Pay for the vehicle and wait for its arrival

After winning an auction through Stat.VIN, you will receive bank details and detailed payment instructions.

Once payment is received, we will collect the vehicle, perform additional photo documentation, and begin preparation for shipment. We accompany you at all stages of importing a vehicle from the USA.

You can track the delivery and documentation status in your personal account on the website. If customs clearance is carried out at the port of Rotterdam, we handle all formalities. 

All you have to do is wait for the vehicle to be delivered directly to your door.

For more detailed information about the next stages, we recommend visiting the “After Purchase” section, which describes a detailed action plan after winning a vehicle, including all subsequent import steps.

FAQ’s

Register on Stat.VIN, add a deposit, and choose a lot on Copart or IAAI. Bidding happens in two stages: Pre-Bid (several days) and Live Auction. Set your maximum — the system holds the best position automatically. After winning, Stat.VIN picks up the car, handles paperwork, and arranges delivery.

Technically yes — but for a one-time purchase it rarely makes financial sense. A Copart membership alone costs $400–600 per year. On top of that, you would need to independently arrange US-side logistics, export documentation, and container loading. Through Stat.VIN all of this is handled for you and included in a single commission.

Open any lot page and go to the Calculator tab. Enter your destination country and the calculator instantly generates a complete cost estimate — covering the auction buyer's fee, Stat.VIN service fee, US inland transport to the port, ocean freight, and applicable import duties and taxes. The calculated amount is final — Stat.VIN guarantees that your invoice will match the calculator estimate with no hidden charges.

Once you win a lot on Stat.VIN, we handle the entire process on your behalf. The car is picked up from the auction lot, loaded for ocean shipping, and transported to your destination country. All export documentation is prepared on the US side. Import clearance, duties, and local registration requirements depend on your country — our team guides you through each step. You can track every stage of the process in real time through your Stat.VIN account.

As is - where is

When you submit a bid through StatVIN, you are offering to pay the auction the specified vehicle at the price you specify. Your final purchase price will include auction fees, StatVIN fees, and other fees as detailed in the Terms and Conditions. The Seller may accept the highest bid placed during the auction, or later counter bids, and thus if you are the highest bidder and your bid or counter offer is accepted, you will be contractually bound to purchase the vehicle at the price you specify plus any applicable auction fees, AutoBidMaster fees, and other fees as detailed in the Terms and Conditions. All bids and sales are final. There is no right of rescission and no refund or exchange rights.

Since this vehicle is being sold "AS IS - WHERE IS", it means that the purchaser is buying it "with all faults" and without any "warranty" or guarantee of any type, express or implied. Any information regarding this vehicle provided by the Seller or Copart is for convenience only. It is your sole responsibility to ascertain, confirm, research, inspect, and investigate a vehicle and any information regarding such vehicle prior to bidding on it. AutoBidMaster expressly disclaims the accuracy of the vehicle information on this page including damage details, odometer readings and vehicle identification numbers (VIN).

For more information, please refer to the Terms & Conditions
